Hi Priya / Jordan —

Thanks again for the time last week. Attaching a starter MAP and the SOC 2 evidence index to get the evaluation moving. High level proposal below (we can tighten during the sync):

- Week 0 (this week): MAP kickoff, stakeholder alignment, handover of SOC 2 index and evidence ownership.
- Week 1–2: Security review (SOC 2 artifact collection, access pattern questions, SSO proof-of-concept).
- Week 3–4: Integration and performance eval (sandbox runs, sample traffic).
- Week 5–6: Final QA, pricing/contract review, executive sign-off. Target close: end of week 6 (Aug 21).

Action items I propose for the first 72 hours:
1) Priya — confirm your SOC 2 POC contact and preferred upload method for artifacts.
2) Jordan — confirm evaluation scope (we attached an MVP scope doc; please flag anything missing).
3) Vivek (GRC) — I’ve looped you for evidence expectations and any gating questions.
4) Neha — I’ll need help coordinating the procurement check-ins and milestones.

Attachments: redwood_map_template.xlsx, soc2-evidence-index.pdf, acme_mvp_scope.docx

If that looks good, can we do a 30-min kickoff on Tuesday 7/14 at 10:00am PT? If that slot doesn’t work, suggest two alternatives and I’ll send calendar invites.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,

Thanks for looping me in. A few items from GRC to help the MAP be actionable: 

1) SOC 2 artifacts we will need (preferred first pass):
   - SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) + bridge letter (if applicable)
   - System description and evidence index (we’ll use the attached soc2-evidence-index.pdf as a template)
   - User access / provisioning screenshots or audit export for production service accounts
   - Incident response summary for the last 24 months (redacted)

2) Data handling / PHI specifics: please confirm whether PHI will be shared in the sandbox. If yes, we require a data minimization statement and encryption-at-rest proof for the test environment.

3) Access model: we prefer a secure transfer (S3 presigned or secure SFTP) and temporary limited access accounts. Please do not share full admin credentials over email.

4) Timeline gating: if the SOC 2 report + access proof is available by end of Week 1, we can proceed with parallel integration in Week 2. If not, the integration window will need to shift by 1–2 weeks.

Can Bob (cc’d) confirm whether Acme can provide an S3 presigned upload link or an SFTP account?

I’ll prepare a short evidence checklist and upload it to the shared drive after the kickoff. Thanks — Vivek.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
